resources.title: Cambridge Primary Global Perspectives Teacher Guide (0838)

curriculum.title: Cambridge Primary Global Perspectives
curriculum.note: Objectives are taken verbatim from the 0838 Primary Global Perspectives Progression Grid in this class folder. The five challenge topics are chosen by the school; the skills they develop are fixed by the framework.

objectives.title: Say something known about an issue
Talk about information recorded in pictograms or graphic organisers
Talk about simple, personal consequences of own actions
Choose a possible solution to an issue from a range of actions given
Work positively with others, sharing resources while working independently or with others
Answer questions with relevant information about a given issue
Listen to others in class discussions and respond with simple questions
Select a source relevant to a given issue and explain reasons for choice
State an opinion about a given issue
Identify personal contribution in the form of an action intended to help achieve a shared outcome
Identify an action that someone else contributed to achieve a shared outcome
Talk about what has been learned during an activity with support
Talk about something liked in a particular activity
Ask basic questions about a given issue
Talk about information on a given issue in sources provided
Begin to participate in simple investigations and ask basic questions to find information and opinions
Record information on a given issue in pictograms or simple graphic organisers

objectives.title: Say something known about an issue

plan.focus: What do we already know about our school?
plan.prior: First lesson of this unit. Draw on what learners already know.
plan.next: Lesson 2: Asking questions about our school
plan.intro: Introduce the issue with a picture or a short story.
main: Learners say one thing they already know about it.

plan.intro: Show two sources about the issue. Which will help us more?
